answer: A claim stands or falls on a live undo. A violet warden picks a finished step from the atlas, and the claimant has one hour to reverse it, restoring its oasis state as an auditor checks each move against the sealed reference. Wrong reversal, copied undo, or silence is a broken undo: void, fee burned, barred a week. Five cents and one reversal buy an honest worker a pass; 1,000 fakes pay $50 and must hire 1,000 workers to unmake work never made.
